result_summary.title: MFA prompts failing and accounts locking in Staging (LATAM)
result_summary.description: We are experiencing a critical issue in our staging environment where the Session Controller is not presenting MFA prompts during login attempts. Consequently, users are being locked out of their accounts after failed attempts without seeing the authentication challenge. This is impacting over 16,000 test users and blocking our release validation. Region is LATAM. Please advise.
